title: AD-CARE: A Guideline-grounded, Modality-agnostic LLM Agent for Real-world Alzheimer’s Disease Diagnosis with Multi-cohort Assessment, Fairness Analysis, and Reader Study

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing diagnostic performance metrics (accuracy, F1 score, sensitivity, specificity) and measuring fairness dispersion (standard deviation and max-min performance gaps) across Asian, Black, and White patient subgroups.

Comparing diagnostic performance metrics (accuracy, F1 score, sensitivity, specificity) and measuring fairness dispersion (standard deviation and max-min performance gaps) across four patient age subgroups (<65, 65-74, 75-84, and >=85 years).
